data.narrative:
Raphe mPhibr is a Series B defense and security company founded by Vivek and Vikash Mishra that has raised $145M+. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 10 total peers—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private—all operating in the same sector and stage.

Two triangulation methods were applied. The stage-progression approach uses the $145M total raised as a baseline proxy and applies a 1.9x multiplier typical of Series B advancement, yielding $276M. The peer-median method examines 7 same-sector, same-stage private companies—Dream Security ($3.0B), Harmattan AI ($1.4B), Code Metal ($1.2B), Castelion ($1.0B), Defense Unicorns ($1.0B), and two others—producing a median valuation of $1.0B with a range of $300M to $3.0B.

Synthesizing these methods yields a triangulated range of $234M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $638M. The stage-progression method anchors the lower bound while peer comparables suggest material upside. Key uncertainties include wide dispersion within the peer set ($300M–$3.0B) and the appropriate weighting of public comps versus private peers. The median estimate of $638M reflects a middle position but should be stress-tested against relative product maturity, revenue scale, and customer concentration relative to the named peer set.
